name: OAI.FourierLLogL.Dyadic.Thermal.Form
text:
/-- coefficient form. Throughout, nonnegativity of the coefficients means `0 ≤ A`. -/
abbrev Form (M : ℕ) := Grid M → ℝ

name: Thermal.wave / cost / form
text:
def wave (s y : Grid M) : ℝ := (chi s y).re
def cost (s y : Grid M) : ℝ := 1-wave s y
def form (A : Form M) : Grid M → ℝ := fun y => ∑ s, A s * cost s y

name: Thermal.boltz / q
text:
def boltz (A : Form M) (y : Grid M) : ℝ := exp (-form A y)
def q (A : Form M) (u : Grid M) : ℝ := (fc (fun y => (↑(boltz A y):ℂ)) u).re

name: Thermal.F / K (free energy, label density K_A = e^{F-A})
text:
def F (A : Form M) := -log (q A 0)
def K (A : Form M) (x : Grid M) : ℝ := boltz A x / q A 0

name: Thermal.label (noise law theta ~ K_A)
text:
/-- Label noise law centered at zero relative to counting measure. -/
def label (A : Form M) : Law (Grid M) :=
  ⟨fun x => side M * K A x, fun x => mul_nonneg (side_pos _).le (K_pos _ _).le, by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    exact K_total _⟩

name: Thermal.cred (thermal Fourier coefficient c_A(u) = int chi_u K_A)
text: def cred (A : Form M) (u : Grid M) := q A u/q A 0

name: Thermal.delta (metric Delta_A)
text: def delta (A : Form M) (s : Grid M) := √((label A).Ex fun i => ‖1-chi s i‖^2)

name: Thermal.channel (the label Z = Y + theta)
Thermal.omegaObs / Mz / fz (label-weighted masses M(z) and moments f(z))
Thermal.S (spatial form S_p = R^2 (1 - Re chi_1))
text:
/-- Spatial form, specified by inverse width -/
def S (M : ℕ) (R : ℝ) : Form M := fun s => if s=1 then R^2 else 0

name: Thermal.place
text: def place (p : Node) (M : ℕ) := S M p.invlen

name: Thermal.Update.next (label update A+ = A + S_p + D_i)
text: def next (u : Update j M p) (A : Form M) : Form M := A+place p M+u.changeForm

name: Procedure.Fund.advance (main channel 'mood' replaced by u.next)
text:
def advance (p : Node) (c : Fund M) (u : Update j M p) : Fund M :=
    ⟨u.next c.mood,p,c.uses+1,c.spend+u.credit,c.bank+u.bill⟩

name: Procedure.hist / diff / fisher (J_p = sum |D|^2/M)
Procedure.givenD / massInfo (per-node label Fisher charge)
Thermal.ginibre (key lemma: Griffiths-Ginibre covariance positivity)
text:
theorem ginibre {A : Form M} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (s t : Grid M) :
    cred A s * cred A t ≤ (label A).Ex (fun i => wave s i * wave t i)

name: Procedure.bit_def (key lemma: Fisher information of label <= 4 x bit relative-entropy deficit)
text:
lemma bit_def (s : Scene M) (k : Grid M → Law α) (hp : s.here.valid)
    (he : s.here.lev < M) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hm : 0 < s.mass) (hn : 0 < s.norm) :
    s.norm/s.mass * fisher s k ≤ 4*(log 2-sideH (step s) k)

name: Procedure.space_deficit (key lemma: one-step chain-rule identity charging the Fisher term to the entropy deficit)
text:
lemma space_deficit (s : Scene M) (k : Grid M → Law α) (hp : s.here.valid)
    (he : s.here.lev < M) (hh : 0 ≤ s.wage) (hm : 0 < s.mass) (hn : 0 < s.norm) :
    (step s).probs.Ex (fun b => deficit (s.smaller b) k) +
      (1/4:ℝ)*(s.norm/s.mass)*fisher s k ≤ deficit s k

name: Procedure.Road.fisher_bound (key lemma: global label Fisher sum <= limitC * height j, i.e. O(d))
text:
lemma fisher_bound :
    ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in atTop, ∀ M J : ℕ, ∀ f : Grid M → ℝ,
      (∀ x, f x ≤ exp (height j)) →
      let s := beginPlay f true
      ∀ t : Road j M s, Trusted J f t → 1/Thermal.H j ≤ s.mass →
        t.flatFee infoFee ≤ limitC* height j

name: Procedure.Paths.Troupe.duet_decode (key lemma: exact decoding identity int chi_k a^v = c_A(k) * scalar(v+k))
text:
lemma duet_decode (s : Scene M) (v k : Grid M) :
    ∑ z, chi k z*letter s v z = (cred (dye s) k:ℂ)*scalar s (v+k)

name: Procedure.Paths.Troupe.energy_near_channel (label energy of v controlled by that of v+k plus Delta_A(k)^2)
text:
lemma energy_near_channel (s : Scene M) (h : Fit s) (v k : Grid M) :
    energy s v ≤ 2*energy s (v+k)+2*(share s*delta (dye s) k^2)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.Law
text:
structure Law where
  support : Finset ℝ
  prob : ℝ → ℝ
  prob_pos : ∀ x ∈ support, 0 < prob x
  prob_sum : ∑ x ∈ support, prob x = 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.Law.edges
text:
noncomputable def Law.edges (ν : Law) (ℓ : ℤ) : Finset (ℝ × ℝ) := by
  classical
  exact (ν.support ×ˢ ν.support).filter fun e =>
    e.1 < e.2 ∧ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-ℓ) ≤ e.2 - e.1 ∧ e.2 - e.1 < (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - ℓ)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.incident
text:
noncomputable def incident {ν : Law} {ℓ : ℤ} (w : ν.edges ℓ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ e, ((if e.val.1 = x then w e / 2 else 0) +
      (if e.val.2 = x then w e / 2 else 0))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.Feasible
text:
def Feasible {ν : Law} {ℓ : ℤ} (w : ν.edges ℓ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ e, 0 ≤ w e) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ν.support, incident w x ≤ ν.prob x

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.capacity
text:
noncomputable def capacity (ν : Law) (ℓ : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  sSup {t : ℝ | ∃ w : ν.edges ℓ → ℝ, Feasible w ∧ ∑ e, w e = t}

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.capacity_le_one
text: theorem capacity_le_one (ν : Law) (ℓ : ℤ) : capacity ν ℓ ≤ 1

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.capacity_attained
text:
theorem capacity_attained (ν : Law) (ℓ : ℤ) :
    ∃ w : ν.edges ℓ → ℝ, Feasible w ∧ ∑ e, w e = capacity ν ℓ

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.coupling_band_le_capacity
text:
theorem coupling_band_le_capacity {ν : Law} (ℓ : ℤ) (π : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hπ : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∀ y ∈ ν.support, 0 ≤ π x y)
    (hsym : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∀ y ∈ ν.support, π x y = π y x)
    (hrow : ∀ x ∈ ν.support, ∑ y ∈ ν.support, π x y ≤ ν.prob x) :
    (∑ x ∈ ν.support, ∑ y ∈ ν.support,
      if (2 : ℝ) ^ (-ℓ) ≤ |y - x| ∧ |y - x| < (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - ℓ)
      then π x y else 0) ≤ capacity ν ℓ

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.Law.bandCost
text:
noncomputable def Law.bandCost (ν : Law) (R : ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ ℓ ∈ ν.bandSupport.filter (fun ℓ => (2 : ℝ)^(-ℓ) ≤ R),
    (2 : ℝ)^(1-ℓ)*capacity ν ℓ

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.FairPairs.pair_bound
text:
theorem pair_bound (ν : Law) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    k*(ν.shannonEntropy-ν.gridEntropy ρ) ≤ Real.log (ν.sumset k).card / Real.log 2 +
      60000*k^4 * ∑ ℓ ∈ ν.bandSupport.filter (fun ℓ => (2 : ℝ)^(-ℓ) ≤ 2*ρ), capacity ν ℓ

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.MeasureEntropy.finiteConv_mean_gain
text:
theorem finiteConv_mean_gain {β : Type uβ} [Fintype β]
    (ν : FairPairs.Law) (a b : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : CompactlyCarried μ)
    (τ : β → Measure ℝ) [∀ z, IsProbabilityMeasure (τ z)]
    (hτ : ∀ z, CompactlyCarried (τ z))
    (p : β → ℝ) (hp : ∀ z, 0 ≤ p z) (hp1 : ∑ z, p z=1)
    (hm : μ.map (fun x => b*x) = ∑ z, ENNReal.ofReal (p z) • τ z)
    {δ η s : ℝ} (hδ : ∀ v, 0 < v → δ ≤ deficit μ v) (hs : 0 < s)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (ℓ : ℤ)
    (hv : ∀ e : ν.edges ℓ, s < |a*e.val.2-a*e.val.1| ∧ |a*e.val.2-a*e.val.1| < N*s)
    (herr : ∀ e : ν.edges ℓ,
      (s/|a*e.val.2-a*e.val.1|+|a*e.val.2-a*e.val.1|/(N*s))*Real.log 2 ≤ η) :
    (δ-η)*FairPairs.capacity ν ℓ ≤
      ∑ z, p z*(window (finiteConv ν a (τ z)) s (N*s)-window (τ z) s (N*s))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Typed.conditional_gain
text:
theorem conditional_gain (S : System α) (tag : α → β)
    (hr : ∀ a v, tag a=tag v → S.ratio a=S.ratio v)
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : S.SelfSimilar μ)
    (hc : CompactlyCarried μ) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : ∀ v, 0 < v → δ ≤ deficit μ v) {M : ℕ} (hM : 4 < M)
    (he : 5/(M : ℝ)*Real.log 2 ≤ δ/2)
    {j n : ℕ} (u : Fin j → α) (w : Fin n → α) (t : ℕ) (L : ℤ) :
    δ/2*capacity (law S tag w) (L-⌈S.wordDepth u⌉) ≤
      ∑ z : Fin t → α, S.wordWeight z*
        (window (scaledTail S tag μ (S.completeMap u).1 (Fin.append w z))
          ((2 : ℝ)^(-L)/M) (((M*M : ℕ) : ℝ)*((2 : ℝ)^(-L)/M))-
        window (scaledTail S tag μ ((S.completeMap u).1*(S.completeMap w).1) z)
          ((2 : ℝ)^(-L)/M) (((M*M : ℕ) : ℝ)*((2 : ℝ)^(-L)/M)))

name: UnitBall
note: Carrier of the coloring: closed unit ball as a subtype.
text: abbrev UnitBall (E : Type uE) [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] := {x : E // ‖x‖ ≤ 1}

name: ballMean
note: Equal-weight mean bundled with its unit-ball proof; the argument of f in the recursion.

name: partitionColor
note: No declaration docstring; the module docstring (RecursiveColoring.lean:6-11) reads: 'Recursive unit-ball colors of actual basic dyadic partitions. The recursion uses the number of actual cells. Restriction to any selected internal interval strictly decreases that number. The mean is bundled with its genuine unit-ball proof before it is supplied to the map.'
text:
def partitionColor (I : Fin D → BasicInterval) (hI : ∀ i, (I i).Internal)
    (hD : 0 < D) (f : UnitBall E → UnitBall E) (T : BasicPartition) :
    UnitBall E := by
  classical
  exact if h : ∀ i, T.Respects (I i) then
    f (ballMean hD (fun i =>
      partitionColor I hI hD f (T.restrict (I i) (h i))))
  else unitBallZero E
termination_by T.cellCount
decreasing_by
  exact T.restrict_cellCount_lt _ _ (hI _)

name: partitionFamilyColor
note: Paper's X_I before pullback (finite-proof.tex:157-165).
text:
/-- The family color is zero whenever the actual partition is inadmissible. -/
def partitionFamilyColor (hD : 0 < D) (f : UnitBall E → UnitBall E)
    (T : BasicPartition) (q : IntervalIndex D) : UnitBall E := by
  classical
  exact if h : PartitionAdmissible D T then
    partitionColor (selectedInterval D) (selectedInterval_internal D) hD f
      (T.restrict (familyInterval D q) (h q))
  else unitBallZero E

name: globalColor
kind: def (pullback of the coloring to F: X_I…
note: No declaration docstring. Paper I23 (color:global).

name: partitionColor_restrict
note: Paper eq. (avg:recursive-identity) X_{I_i}=f(z_i), via (T_I)_J = T_{I.J}.
text:
/-- Applying the recursion to a parent restriction gives the actual child mean.
The normalized two-step restriction is replaced by the proved composite one. -/
theorem partitionColor_restrict (I : Fin D → BasicInterval)
    (hI : ∀ i, (I i).Internal) (hD : 0 < D)
    (f : UnitBall E → UnitBall E) (T : BasicPartition) (i : Fin D)
    (hparent : T.Respects (I i))
    (hchild : ∀ j, T.Respects ((I i).comp (I j))) :
    partitionColor I hI hD f (T.restrict (I i) hparent) =
      f (ballMean hD (fun j => partitionColor I hI hD f
        (T.restrict ((I i).comp (I j)) (hchild j)))) := ...

name: partitionFamilyColor_parent
text:
/-- A parent's color is the map applied to its actual child-color mean. -/
theorem partitionFamilyColor_parent (hD : 0 < D)
    (f : UnitBall E → UnitBall E) (T : BasicPartition)
    (h : PartitionAdmissible D T) (i : Fin D) :
    partitionFamilyColor hD f T (.inl i) =
      f (ballMean hD (fun j => partitionFamilyColor hD f T (.inr (i, j)))) := ...

name: globalColor_covariance
note: Paper eq. (dyad:covariance).
text:
/-- Source and target admissibility suffice; the transport need not preserve
any other selected interval. -/
theorem globalColor_covariance (hD : 0 < D) (f : UnitBall E → UnitBall E)
    (n : ℕ) (h g : F) (q r : IntervalIndex D)
    (hc : CarriesAffinely h (familyInterval D q) (familyInterval D r))
    (hg : GlobalAdmissible D n g) (hhg : GlobalAdmissible D n (h * g)) :
    globalColor hD f n q g = globalColor hD f n r (h * g) := ...

name: displacement_le_mean_energy
note: Paper eq. (avg:displacement).
text:
/-- The pointwise inequality obtained from the actual recursive colors. -/
theorem displacement_le_mean_energy {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (f : UnitBall E → UnitBall E) (L δ : ℝ)
    (_hL : 0 < L) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hLip : ∀ u v, ‖(f u : E) - f v‖ ≤ L * ‖(u : E) - v‖)
    (hDisp : ∀ u, δ ≤ ‖(f u : E) - u‖)
    (x z : Fin D → UnitBall E) (hrec : ∀ i, x i = f (z i)) :
    δ ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 * (D : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      ∑ i, ‖(z i : E) - (ballMean hD x : E)‖ ^ 2 := ...

name: boundaryConstant_le_of_correlations
note: Generic over any index type G -- the reusable abstract criterion.
text:
theorem boundaryConstant_le_of_correlations (A : Finset G) (hA : A.Nonempty)
    (hD : 2 ≤ D) (f : UnitBall E → UnitBall E) (L δ α η : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hLip : ∀ u v, ‖(f u : E) - f v‖ ≤ L * ‖(u : E) - v‖)
    (hDisp : ∀ u, δ ≤ ‖(f u : E) - u‖)
    (x : G → Fin D → UnitBall E) (y : G → Fin D → Fin D → UnitBall E)
    (hrec : ∀ g ∈ A, ∀ i,
      x g i = f (ballMean (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 2) hD) (y g i)))
    (hparent : ∀ j k, j ≠ k →
      |corr A (fun g => (x g j : E)) (fun g => (x g k : E)) - α| ≤ η)
    (hchild : ∀ i j k, j ≠ k →
      |corr A (fun g => (y g i j : E)) (fun g => (y g i k : E)) - α| ≤ η)
    (hmixed : ∀ i j k, k ≠ i →
      |corr A (fun g => (y g i j : E)) (fun g => (x g k : E)) - α| ≤ η) :
    boundaryConstant L δ D ≤ η := ...

name: exists_fixed_boundary
note: Proof assembles the coloring, transports and the generic core.
text:
theorem exists_fixed_boundary (f : UnitBall E → UnitBall E) (L δ : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, ‖(f x : E) - f y‖ ≤ L * ‖(x : E) - y‖)
    (hDisp : ∀ x, δ ≤ ‖(f x : E) - x‖)
    (D : ℕ) (hD : 2 ≤ D) (hlarge : 4 * L ^ 2 / δ ^ 2 < (D : ℝ)) :
    ∃ S : Finset F, S.Nonempty ∧ 0 < boundaryConstant L δ D ∧
      ∀ A : Finset F, A.Nonempty →
        ∃ h ∈ S, boundaryConstant L δ D ≤ boundaryRatio A h := ...

name: Stable
note: Stability predicate used throughout (no zero on the open upper half-plane product). Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
def Stable {σ : Type*} (p : MvPolynomial σ ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ z ∈ Upper, MvPolynomial.eval z p ≠ 0

name: permutationSymbol
note: THE ITEM: F_pi(x,y) = prod_i (x_i + y_{pi(i)}) over variables V ⊕ V. No docstring in source. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
def permutationSymbol (π : Equiv.Perm V) : MvPolynomial (V ⊕ V) ℂ :=
  ∏ i, (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i) + MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr (π i)))

name: stable_permutationSymbol
note: Deterministic symbol is stable. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text: lemma stable_permutationSymbol (π : Equiv.Perm V) : Stable (permutationSymbol π) := by

name: lawSymbol
note: Expected symbol E F_pi for a finite law mu on permutations. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
def lawSymbol (μ : Ω → ℝ) (π : Ω → Equiv.Perm V) : MvPolynomial (V ⊕ V) ℂ :=
  ∑ ω, MvPolynomial.C (μ ω : ℂ) * permutationSymbol (π ω)

name: stable_lawSymbol_bernoulli
note: Composing with an independent Bernoulli(u) transposition preserves stability (partial symmetrization). Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
theorem stable_lawSymbol_bernoulli (μ : Ω → ℝ) (π : Ω → Equiv.Perm V)
    (hs : Stable (lawSymbol μ π)) (i j : V) {u : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ u) (h1 : u ≤ 1) :
    Stable (lawSymbol (fun z : Bool × Ω => (if z.1 then u else 1 - u) * μ z.2)
      (fun z : Bool × Ω => (if z.1 then Equiv.swap i j else 1) * π z.2)) := by

name: stable_lawSymbol_limit
note: Limits of stable law symbols are stable (Hurwitz). Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
theorem stable_lawSymbol_limit {ι : Type*} {φ : Filter ι} [φ.NeBot]
    (μ : ι → Ω → ℝ) (ν : Ω → ℝ) (π : Ω → Equiv.Perm V)
    (hc : ∀ ω, Filter.Tendsto (fun i => μ i ω) φ (nhds (ν ω)))
    (hν : ∑ ω, ν ω = 1) (hs : ∀ᶠ i in φ, Stable (lawSymbol (μ i) π)) :
    Stable (lawSymbol ν π) := by

name: stable_outputSymbol
note: Output extraction: the subset generating polynomial of pi(T) is stable. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
theorem stable_outputSymbol (μ : Ω → ℝ) (π : Ω → Equiv.Perm V)
    (hμ : ∑ ω, μ ω ≠ 0) (hs : Stable (lawSymbol μ π)) (T : Finset V) :
    Stable (outputSymbol μ (fun ω => π ω) T) := by

name: spliceVariables
note: Identifies the input and output variable of the deleted vertex (none) into one variable t. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
def spliceVariables : Option V ⊕ Option V → Option (V ⊕ V)
  | Sum.inl none => none
  | Sum.inr none => none
  | Sum.inl (some i) => some (Sum.inl i)
  | Sum.inr (some i) => some (Sum.inr i)

name: eraseNone
note: Sets t = 0 after differentiation. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
def eraseNone {σ : Type*} : MvPolynomial (Option σ) ℂ →ₐ[ℂ] MvPolynomial σ ℂ :=
  MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j => j.elim 0 MvPolynomial.X)

name: splice
note: THE SPLICING OPERATION: identify x_q = y_q = t, take the linear coefficient in t. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
def splice (p : MvPolynomial (Option V ⊕ Option V) ℂ) : MvPolynomial (V ⊕ V) ℂ :=
  eraseNone (MvPolynomial.pderiv none (MvPolynomial.rename spliceVariables p))

name: spliceWeight
note: Weight 2 when the deleted vertex is a fixed point (closed cycle), else 1. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text: def spliceWeight (π : Equiv.Perm (Option V)) : ℝ := if π none = none then 2 else 1

name: splice_permutationSymbol
note: Defining property: splicing a deterministic symbol gives spliceWeight times the symbol of the spliced permutation. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
lemma splice_permutationSymbol (π : Equiv.Perm (Option V)) :
    splice (permutationSymbol π) =
      MvPolynomial.C (spliceWeight π : ℂ) * permutationSymbol (Equiv.removeNone π) := by

name: stable_spliced_law
note: Splicing preserves stability of a law symbol, producing the weight-2 reweighted law. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
theorem stable_spliced_law (μ : Ω → ℝ) (π : Ω → Equiv.Perm (Option V))
    (hμ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ μ ω) (hpos : 0 < ∑ ω, μ ω) (hs : Stable (lawSymbol μ π)) :
    Stable (lawSymbol (fun ω => μ ω * spliceWeight (π ω))
      (fun ω => Equiv.removeNone (π ω))) := by

name: cycle_weight_splice
note: Combinatorial identity: deleting one unpinned vertex multiplies 2^{#cycles missing pins} correctly. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
theorem cycle_weight_splice (π : Perm (Option V)) (P : Set V) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ missingCount π (some '' P) =
      (if π none = none then 2 else 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ missingCount (removeNone π) P := by

name: pinLaw
note: Spliced symbol F_P = E[2^{n_P} prod_{i in P}(x_i + y_{sigma(i)})] of the next-pin permutation. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.

name: stable_pinLaw
note: Key lemma: the spliced pin-law symbol is stable for every pin set P. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
theorem stable_pinLaw {V : Type u} [Fintype V] (μ : Ω → ℝ) (π : Ω → Perm V)
    (hμ : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ μ ω) (hpos : 0 < ∑ ω, μ ω) (hs : Stable (lawSymbol μ π))
    (P : Set V) : Stable (pinLaw μ π P) := by

name: stable_symmetrize
note: Partial symmetrization closure lemma (BBL Thm 4.20 analogue). Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
theorem stable_symmetrize {p : MvPolynomial σ ℂ} (hp : Stable p)
    (hm : MultiAffine p) (i j : σ) {u : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ u) (h1 : u ≤ 1) :
    Stable (symmetrize p i j u) := by

name: presence_product
note: Presence inequality from stability (BBL Thm 4.9 consequence). Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.
text:
theorem presence_product {μ : Finset σ → ℝ} (hμ : ∀ A, 0 ≤ μ A)
    (h₁ : presence μ ∅ = 1) (hs : Stable (presencePolynomial μ ∅))
    (J : Finset σ) : presence μ J ≤ ∏ j ∈ J, presence μ {j} := by

name: finite_simultaneous_pin_test
note: Decisive use: P_E(T on cycles avoiding E) <= (2 r)^{|T|}. Text is verbatim source lines; proofs (after `:= by`) omitted.

theorem finite_simultaneous_pin_test (μ : Ω → ℝ) (π : Ω → Equiv.Perm V)
